title: Schedule Posts on Every Platform at Once with Claude
description:
Claude can now manage your entire social media. Using the Metricool MCP connector, Claude connects to Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, Meta Ads, and Google Ads so you can schedule posts, pull analytics, find your best posting time, and analyze competitors, all from one chat. This is the fastest Claude AI social media automation and AI workflow automation setup for content creators and marketers. If you want the full step by step, watch the short and grab the guide below.

Get the full setup guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/15qC-BzXyJnhMWD2iDfgSCPFrKfHlkD05/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=110897400342351178452&rtpof=true&sd=true
